buckets.name: Agent tools
buckets.title: Bike, dock and scooter availability an agent can look up
buckets.build: Wrap one station_status or vehicle_status URL as a get_bike_availability tool: pass the system and a station or a point, return bikes, e-bikes and open docks, or the nearest available vehicles, with the feed's last_updated time.
buckets.filter_text: tags has agent-ready AND url matches /station_status|free_bike_status|vehicle_status/i

notes.text: are `station_status` files (bikes and open docks per station or parking hub); the others list dockless vehicles (`free_bike_status` or `vehicle_status`).

recommended.criteria: Services in this pack with the most endpoints that match this bucket and are tagged `agent-ready` (no key sent in the test call, JSON body, passed a data call). Ties go to the service with more country codes, then by name. Only services with at least one bucket row that matches the focus rule are listed, and the sample comes from those rows; the counts cover the whole bucket. The sample URL is the first row by URL sort after preferring, in this order: rows that match the bucket's sample preference when it has one, rows that return values rather than describe a dataset or a service (not ERDDAP /info/ pages, OGC GetCapabilities requests, bare OWS addresses, PxWeb tables, UN SDG series lists, Statistics Canada download pointers, WorldPop listings, GTFS validation reports, untitled rows or service root addresses), and agent-ready rows. Sample preference in this bucket: `(url matches /station_status/i AND NOT host in (mds.bird.co, gbfs.api.ridedott.com, gbfs.spin.pm, data.lime.bike, zeus.city, cluster-prod.veoride.com, api.voiapp.io, mds.bolt.eu)) OR (url matches /free_bike_status|vehicle_status/i AND host in (mds.bird.co, gbfs.api.ridedott.com, gbfs.spin.pm, data.lime.bike, zeus.city, cluster-prod.veoride.com, api.voiapp.io, mds.bolt.eu))`. Services named "ArcGIS organization" hold map layers from many owners and are added only when fewer than 5 other services match.

limits.text: 20.2% of rows carry country code FR; 11 rows have no code (global or unknown).
185 rows are map-layer queries with resultRecordCount set: the tested call asked for a few records; change the query to get the full layer.
15 rows carry limit=1: the tested call asked for one record; raise the limit or page through.
161 rows are open-data portal dataset records, which may return a dataset record with links rather than the table itself.
27 rows are files (zip 27) rather than bodies an agent reads directly.
140 rows are layers on ArcGIS Online, where anyone can publish: some are class projects, tests or copies. Check the owner and the fields before you rely on one.
1,201 rows are car-sharing feeds published in GBFS (Getaround, Citiz, autopartage and carsharing services), not bikes or scooters; they are not used as starting points.
13 rows are map layers of shared-use paths, shared roads or piers that hold no bike-share data.

11 rows are planning or status layers (proposed, preliminary, closed, temporary, internal, survey or demand-study stations) that may not show stations in service; they are not used as starting points.
34 rows are past trips, ridership counts, inspections or station readings: history, not current availability.
3,257 rows are availability files whose values can change from minute to minute; the body on the test date is a past state, so fetch the URL again for current counts.

GBFS feeds in this pack use more than one version of the specification (2.x and 3.0 paths both appear); version 3.0 renames free_bike_status to vehicle_status and changes some fields, so read the version from gbfs.json or gbfs_versions before you parse.
Stations and feeds can go quiet after their test date; re-test a URL before you rely on it.
Not in this pack: endpoints that need a key or a POST, and URLs that did not pass.
Left out: 2 ArcGIS Survey123 layers (they can hold people's form answers).
Left out: 1 ArcGIS layer that keeps a form's default service name (it can hold people's form answers).

Left out: 1 ArcGIS class or coursework layer (lab, assignment, exam, quiz, lesson, exercise, tutorial and final-project layers, copies of class layers, layers named for a person or a person's home, and layers whose name ends in a person's name or holds a student number).
